notes.title: v2.0.1 Major Update Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
[v2.0.1 Major Update Schedule Information]
Scheduled Release Date: [strike]2/28[/strike]  [strike]3/7[/strike] 3/14

Here’s what’s new:[olist]
 Introduction of the transmission function.
 Added multi-setting functionality for transmission cameras.
 New transmission tutorial included.
 Adjustments to font and icon sizes.
 Implementation of the login feature.
 Improved image quality for the Media Plan.
[/olist]
Stay tuned for the update!

notes.title: XROOMLite V1.1.4 Update
notes.notes:
Update

 Added 5 types of MediaPlane
 Added Help ContactUs (BugReport)


BugFix

 Fixed issue with DragDrop Object unique ID duplication causing Load problems
 Fixed Decal Save Load and Clone Save Data change errors
 Fixed SpawnedActor Clone Material duplication errors
 Changed to fullscreen mode on editor launch

notes.title: XROOMLite V1.1.3 Update
notes.notes:
Update

 Added shortcuts for project File New, Save, Load: Ctrl + N, S, O
 Implemented copy using Ctrl + C, V
 Applied Move To Actor even when selecting more than two objects
 Modified HELP UI and SnapSize UI
 Demodularized floor object (size 500cm²)


BugFix

 Fixed issue where existing objects were not removed during SaveLoad
 Fixed issue where UI appeared multiple times during Save
 Fixed issue where objects spawned via DragDrop couldn't change color
 Fixed issue where changing Plane Scale Gizmo did not update TransformAttribute size display correctly
 Fixed issue where reselecting MultiObject within Layer caused display errors
